contracts.asserts: Gain interpolation, vector direction, saturation and rounding
Frame timing, independent histories and persistence callbacks

limits: Injected time proves calculation for that input, not BLE arrival jitter or real NVS power-loss behavior.

execution.default: quick: every behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same scenarios plus optimized, coverage and existing 32-bit variants
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

fixtures.asserts: Real full runtime entry rejects empty, unrelated and partially measured coverage with recording tools; actual full entry retains per-function executable line and branch measurement

Exact supported core/dependency pins, clean sources, missing inputs, nonoverlapping project paths separate from west/config metadata, fresh outputs outside source/dependency roots including symlink aliases, and parseable wrong custom-settings archive; identity and archive hash bypass controls

infrastructure.preparation: Explicit pinned offline workspace; local unchanged ZMK clone and original fixture manifest; no fetch or source repair
infrastructure.limits: Admission tests control dependency responses. Actual native/API/firmware fixtures separately verify unchanged stock ZMK and DYA. Physical transport remains separate.
